orgs.name: WASHINGTON COUNTY COMMUNITY CONNECT
services: THE FRONT DOOR for homelessness help in Washington County, Oregon. Community Connect does not hand out rent checks itself — it is how the county's housing and shelter money is allocated, so start here

Phone assessment (Phase 1) screens your situation and connects eligible callers to eviction prevention, rapid resolution, rapid rehousing (up to 2 years of rent help + case management), permanent supportive housing, Shelter Plus Care, VASH and Regional Long-term Rental Assistance
Access points: call 503-640-3263, email communityconnect@caowash.org, or complete a Phase 1 assessment at a Community Action Multi-Service Center or partner Access Center
orgs.serves: people in Washington County, Oregon who are experiencing homelessness or at risk of losing their housing
